notes.title: MAF Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content: [p]Thank you to everyone for your feedback while our team worked on fixing some aspects of MAF! We have a small update to discuss, so let's go over it. ːsteamhappyː[/p][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Steam achievements are re-enabled and should trigger correctly[/p][list][*][p]Does not apply to current saves, so thresholds will have to be triggered again.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Modified the animations for some crops to be less jarring[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now spawn after many rounds[/p][/*][*][p]The ranged stat items now properly change attack range of weapons[/p][list][*][p]Previously, this just modified the lifetime of player projectiles. Now this also applies to target acquisition range.[/p][/*][*][p]This is mainly applicable to the carrot item.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fade In/Out between loading zones[/p][/*][*][p]Added green particle effects when the player regens health through the health regen stat[/p][/*][*][p]Added SFX to encyclopedia[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, please continue to post any improvement, recommendations, or bugs to Steam. We'll keep an eye out and fix things as they come up![/p][p][/p][p]MAF[/p]

notes.title: MAF Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, apologies for breaking things! This hotfix fixes the load issue from the combat level back to the farm! [/p][p][/p][p]There may potentially be issues with steam achievements, we are looking into the issue and we'll get a fix out asap![/p][p][/p][p]Fixes:
- Loading from death screen in combat level to farm now works properly

Known Bugs:
- The issue was caused by a backend issue with Steam Achievements. The fix may cause some achievements to not unlock properly.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0 - End of Early Access
notes.content: [p]Thank you to all who tested the game early and gave feedback! It moves us greatly to know that even a small project can bring a lot of joy! ːsteamhappyːNow, for the real dill...[/p][h2]Major Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Steam achievements added[/p][list][*][p]There seven achievements in total:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="128,304"][tr][th colwidth="128"][p]Name[/p][/th][th colwidth="304"][p]Description[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="128"][p]To New Hay[/p][/td][td colwidth="304"][p]Complete your first round of combat[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="128"][p]Armsman[/p][/td][td colwidth="304"][p]Completed a round with every weapon[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="128"][p]Glutton[/p][/td][td colwidth="304"][p]Purchased every item from the workshop to their highest value[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="128"][p]Shepard[/p][/td][td colwidth="304"][p]Purchased every item from the animal pens to their highest value[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="128"][p]Glorious![/p][/td][td colwidth="304"][p]Completed all progression within the animals pens and workshop[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="128"][p]It’s a feature[/p][/td][td colwidth="304"][p]Have a ludicrous amount of attack speed[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="128"][p]Unleashed[/p][/td][td colwidth="304"][p]Purchase the chaos box and play a round with it![/p][/td][/tr][/table][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Farming Fields added to the farm[/p][list][*][p]Seeds drop during combat defeating certain enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Plant seeds in given farm fields to grow them. Every round played advances their growth stage by one. Harvesting finished crops yields a one time use buff that grants strong bonuses. See if you can try them all![/p][/*][*][p]Crops added:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="94,"][tr][th colwidth="94"][p]Crop[/p][/th][th][p]Effect[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="94"][p]Korn[/p][/td][td][p]Drops a kernel of corn when moving, explodes for damage after a set amount of time. Scales off highest damage stat.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="94"][p]Raspberry[/p][/td][td][p]Reflects the last enemy attack that hits back. Melee is an all around AoE. Ranged is a circle of projectiles. Cool-down of 5 seconds.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="94"][p]Watermelon[/p][/td][td][p]Protective hat. Provides 5 extra armor and after the player receives more than 10% of their max health, heal a small amount.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="94"][p]Spomple[/p][/td][td][p]After taking melee damage, player gains 10% attack speed for 5 seconds. Stacks up to 8 times. Last 5 seconds. Stack can be gained every second.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="94"][p]‘quash[/p][/td][td][p]Gives players bouncing projectiles [/p][/td][/tr][/table][/*][*][p]There are multiple farm plots that a player can have. One is given upon completing a round, the rest can be bought with hay.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Small Changes[/h2][list][*][p]When crops are consumed, they are added to the player HUD and inventory screens to indicate they are active in combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Speed of panther and small cat have been reduced. [strike]Yay! Less suffering![/strike][/p][/*][*][p]Base drop amount of hay have been doubled. Rate of increase is the same per wave.[/p][/*][*][p]Sword icon in weapon selection has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI tweaks for the farm and various shops.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted attack speed upgrades to be more impactful.[/p][/*][*][p]Chaos box now indicates what stat is impacted in the pause menu within combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy damage indicators adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Settings save correctly when adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Music now replays after first completing.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Known Bugs ːsteammockingː[/h3][list][*][p]Sword attack speed varying upon first launch. [/p][/*][/list][p]As always, if you find additional bugs within the game, report them on on Steam page or community section. Feedback greatly helps improve the game![/p][p][/p][p]For further development, we plan on fixes a few bugs as found. Development will be put on hold while our team winds down and focuses on new projects. Follow our social media to keep up to date![/p]
